summary: Have fun while learning with Vlad and Nikita educational games!
description:
Discover Vlad and Niki Educational Games and enjoy while learning with your favorite brothers!

These games help to develop children's reasoning skills and improve their concentration. Challenging puzzles and memory games, … your kids will boost their intelligence while having fun with Vlad and Niki!

Thanks to this game collection, children will learn with Vlad and Niki to:

- Sort objects and shapes by shape, color or size.
- Associate shapes and silhouettes.
- Develop visual and spatial intelligence.
- Solve educational puzzles.
- Boost their imagination 

INTELLECTUAL DEVELOPMENT: FOCUS AND MEMORY

Vlad and Niki Educational Games provide many benefits for developing children's abilities:

-Improve their capacity for observation, analysis, concentration and attention. Exercise their visual memory with Vlad and Niki.
- Help to identify and establish relationships between shapes and silhouettes, improving spatial and visual perception.
-Vlad and Niki will help you to improve fine motor skills and coordination.

In addition, Vlad and Niki Educational Games offer positive reinforcement with cheerful animations when the child completes the puzzle correctly, helping them increase their self-esteem.

FEATURES

- Vlad & Niki official app
- Classic and fun games 
- Different difficulty levels
- Simple and intuitive interface
- Fun designs and animations
- Original sounds and voices of Vlad and Niki
- Stimulates creativity and flexible thinking
- Completely free game

ABOUT VLAD & NIKI

Vlad and Niki are two brothers known for their videos about toys and stories from daily life. They have become one of the most important influencers among children, with millions of subscribers around the world.

In these games you will find your favorite characters to encourage you to solve the puzzles and smart challenges they propose. Have fun with them while stimulating your brain!
